card.name: Upper end of lab-value ranges
card.fires_on: Numbers and words inside lab-threshold ranges in dose-adjustment tables, such as platelet, neutrophil or kidney-function cutoffs, mostly the last digit of the upper bound or a word like greater or x after it.

modes.label: Range upper bound
modes.description: A digit inside the second number of a lab range, such as 20 to 2x or 700 to 99x.
